title: No keyboard click sound on Mac (Slow Keys click sounds, or real switch sounds)
short_title: No typing click sound on your Mac? What macOS can and cannot do

verify.notes: Apple's Mac User Guide page on Slow Keys (read 2026-10-26) gives the path Apple menu, System Settings, Accessibility, Keyboard, and says Use click key sounds plays a feedback sound each time the Mac responds to a keystroke; Slow Keys adds a delay between the key press and the response. The check is a read-only defaults read on Ben's Mac mini (macOS 27.0.1), where Slow Keys is off and the key reads 0; nothing was changed. Keyfeel's page states it plays recorded keyboard-switch sounds on each key press, runs in the menu bar and works offline, and uses key codes, never the characters typed. The forum thread shows a person asking for key click sounds on a Mac.

scenes.title: No keyboard click sound
scenes.narration: Some people want to hear a click when they type on a Mac, the way a phone keyboard clicks. macOS does not have a setting for that. Here is the closest built-in option, and what it costs.

scenes.text: macOS has no typing sound setting. The nearest option is part of Slow Keys.
scenes.narration: Unlike an iPhone, a Mac has no keyboard click setting. The nearest built-in option sits inside Slow Keys, an accessibility feature.

scenes.label: System Settings
lines: Turn on Slow Keys, then click the info button
Turn on Use click key sounds
scenes.ui: Slow Keys also delays each key press.
scenes.narration: Open System Settings, click Accessibility, then Keyboard. Turn on Slow Keys, click the info button, and turn on Use click key sounds. Be aware that Slow Keys also adds a delay between pressing a key and the Mac responding, which most fast typists will not want.

scenes.label: Terminal
scenes.narration: To see whether Slow Keys is on right now, this setting reads zero when it is off.

scenes.name: Keyfeel
scenes.line: Plays recorded keyboard-switch sounds on each key press from the menu bar, offline, using key codes and never the characters you type.
scenes.narration: Keyfeel is a menu bar app that plays recorded keyboard switch sounds when you press a key, and it works offline. It uses which key was pressed, never the characters you type.
